description: This Java class provides utility methods for enhancing and removing connection ID and correlation ID information in logging contexts, specifically for use with SLF4J MDC and Akka DiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

classes.name: ConnectionLogUtil
classes.description: Utility class for adding/removing connection and correlation IDs to logging contexts.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithConnectionId
methods.description: Adds connection ID to MDC or logging adapter.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdAndConnectionId
methods.description: Adds correlation ID and connection ID to MDC or logging adapter.

methods.name: removeConnectionId
methods.description: Removes connection ID from MDC or logging adapter.
